questions_and_answers.question_text: मेरा छोटा लड़का कल नेपाल गया ।

answers.answer_text: My younger boy went to Nepal yesterday.

questions_and_answers.question_text: मेरे दोस्त की लड़की भी उसके साथ गई ।

answers.answer_text: My friend's daughter also went with him.

questions_and_answers.question_text: हम लोग परसों सिनेमा देखने गये थे ।

answers.answer_text: The day before yesterday we went to watch a movie.

questions_and_answers.question_text: आज हमारे चाचा जी भी वही सिनेमा देखने गये हैं ।

answers.answer_text: Today our uncle also went to see the same movie.

questions_and_answers.question_text: रास्ते में हम सब लोग अपने दोस्त के यहाँ दो घंटे ठहरे ।

answers.answer_text: On the way, we all stayed at our friend's place for two hours.

questions_and_answers.question_text: वापसी में वे लोग भी हमारे साथ खाना खाने आये ।

answers.answer_text: On the way back they also came with us to eat.
